context: Central · Northern · Waterloo & City · DLR · Monument interchange

steps.cueText: This is not a quick change — allow several minutes and expect escalators plus a walk between the Bank and Monument halves of the complex.
steps.instruction: Budget real time for this transfer.

steps.cueText: The route between lines here isn't a straight corridor — trust the coloured line roundels over your sense of direction.
steps.instruction: Follow the line-colour signage the whole way, not just at the start.

summary: One of the most complex interchanges on the network — walking transfers between some lines here are commonly over five minutes via escalators and passageways, not a simple cross-platform change.
